Brennt den Kessel gezielt aus, bis weder: Burns the boiler out until neither embers nor unburnt fuel remain in the burner - after that it is ready for cleaning. This is how you shut the boiler down before cleaning, maintenance and service work. The process takes a while and cannot be cancelled.
Damit meldest du der Anlage, dass die Re: This tells the system that the cleaning is done: the maintenance counters start over. Really confirm?
Damit wird der Kessel ein- bzw. ausgesch: Switches the boiler on or off. Switched off it heats neither heating circuits nor domestic hot water - only frost protection stays active.
Das Estrichprogramm fährt ein festes Tem: The screed drying program runs a fixed temperature profile over several days and cannot simply be cancelled. Really start?
Das Schaubild konnte nicht geladen werde: The diagram could not be loaded.
Das mitgelieferte Dashboard baut sich be: The bundled dashboard rebuilds itself from the system every time it is opened and therefore cannot be edited. This text is its state as of today - pasted into a new dashboard it is yours.
Der Kessel brennt den restlichen Brennst: The boiler burns off the remaining fuel and then comes to a standstill. This takes a while and consumes fuel. Really trigger?
Der Kessel fährt auf die eingestellte Ka: The boiler runs at the configured chimney sweep output and holds it for the flue gas measurement. Switching off returns the operating mode to ON; after 60 minutes the measurement ends by itself.
Der Kessel kehrt in den normalen Betrieb: The boiler returns to normal operation. A flue gas measurement in progress is no longer valid afterwards.
Der Zwischenbehälter am Kessel, nicht de: The hopper at the boiler, not the storage room. If the system reports „refill fuel“ it keeps heating until the rest is used up; at „hopper empty“ it blocks the burner.
Der hydraulische Aufbau, gezeichnet aus: The hydraulic layout, drawn from what the system reports. Red is the flow, blue the return; a pump turns as long as it is running.
Die Anlage als Schaubild, mit Werten und: The system as a diagram, with values and running pumps.
Die Anlage meldet mindestens eine aktive: The system reports at least one active fault.
Die Anlagendaten konnten nicht geladen w: The system data could not be loaded.
Die Anordnung konnte nicht gespeichert w: The arrangement could not be saved.
Die Anordnung konnte nicht zurückgesetzt: The arrangement could not be reset.
Die Bedienungen, die man im Alltag wirkl: The controls you actually touch day to day.
Die Eingriffe am Kessel. Die Bestätigung: The interventions at the boiler. Each confirmation button resets only the one counter it belongs to - please press it once the work is done.
Die Farbwahl konnte nicht gespeichert we: The colour choice could not be saved.
Die Legionellenschaltung heizt den Speic: The legionella protection heats the cylinder to a high temperature. Really trigger?
Die Verbrennungsregelung stellt sich auf: The combustion control adapts to the selected fuel. If the setting does not match the actual supply, the boiler runs less efficiently. The change takes effect only after the boiler has been switched off and on again at the main switch. Really change?
Die Werte, die den Zustand der ganzen An: The values that describe the state of the whole system - modelled on the info level of the control unit.
Die eigene Anordnung aller vier Reiter v: Discard your own arrangement of all four tabs? Order, widths, hidden cards and column count will be lost.
Die eigene Anordnung konnte nicht gelade: Your own arrangement could not be loaded.
Die eingestellte Warmwassertemperatur is: The configured hot water temperature is the switch-off point - charging starts as soon as the temperature drops about 5 K below it.
This system reports no time programs.
Ein eigener Wochenplan für weitere Tage: A separate weekly plan for further days
Ein hier gesetzter Wert gilt befristet u: A value set here applies temporarily and then returns to the operating mode by itself; the time programs stay unchanged. The system calls this „Eco / Comfort“ - meant for lowering while airing or heating up for a few hours. Duration 0 to 400 minutes, temperature 6 to 30 °C.
Erst anfordern, dann warten, bis „freige: Request first, then wait until it says „released“. Before that, fill only to about one metre of fill height, otherwise the agitator can be damaged.
Erst beenden, wenn die Befüllung abgesch: End it only once the filling is complete. The agitator stands still afterwards.
Folgt dem Erscheinungsbild von Home Assi: Follows the appearance of Home Assistant
Grundlage der Heizkurve: Die Anlage erre: Basis of the heating curve: the system calculates the flow temperature from it. Which sensor applies here can be set under Configure → General.
Je Kreis die gemessene Raumtemperatur, d: Per circuit the measured room temperature, the current mode and the setpoint. A value set at the thermostat applies temporarily and returns by itself; the time programs stay untouched.
Jede Linie lässt sich an- und abschalten: Every line can be switched on and off. Preselected are the system temperatures, the outside temperature and the boiler output.
Karten am Griff ziehen, in der Breite än: Drag cards by the handle, change their width or hide them; plus the column count. This applies only to you and only to this tab. The colour set below applies to the whole interface.

Meldungen der Anlage im Klartext. Fehler: Messages from the system in plain text. Errors and alarms must be reset at the control unit before the system continues.
At least one block is needed.
Restlaufzeiten bis zur nächsten Arbeit,: Remaining runtimes until the next task, fuel and meter readings. When a remaining runtime reaches zero, the system requests the task.
Schaltet den Kessel ein oder aus. Ausges: Switches the boiler on or off. Switched off it supplies neither heating circuits nor domestic hot water; frost protection stays active.
So viele Spalten, wie nebeneinander pass: As many columns as fit side by side
Soll die Lagerraumbefüllung jetzt durchg: Carry out the storage room filling now? The system releases it only if its state allows - whether it is released and for how long is then shown under „Fill storage room“.
Verbleibende Betriebsstunden bis Ascheen: Remaining operating hours until ash removal, main cleaning and maintenance. The work is done at the boiler and confirmed in the Control tab.
Verbleibende Betriebsstunden bis zur näc: Remaining operating hours until the next task. When the value runs out, the system requests it; it is confirmed with the matching button in the Control tab.
Verschiebt alle Raumtemperatur-Sollwerte: Shifts all room temperature setpoints of this heating circuit - time programs, heating and setback mode - by the same amount, without changing the base settings. Range −3.0 to +3.0 K.
Vorgabe beenden und zum Programm zurückk: End override and return to the program
Was der Kessel gerade tut — von Standby: What the boiler is doing right now - from standby through pre-purge, ignition and stabilisation to modulation and burnout.
Was gerade verheizt wird und wie voll de: What is currently being burnt and how full the hopper is - not the storage room, but the intermediate container at the boiler.
Werte, die nur nach oben laufen. Home As: Values that only ever increase. Home Assistant keeps long-term statistics from them; the increase can be read in the History tab.
Wie lange die aktuelle Freigabe noch gil: How much longer the current release applies. After that the system resets by itself.
Wirkt erst, wenn die Betriebswahl auf „A: Takes effect only when the operating mode is „Auto with time program“.
Wirkt erst, wenn die Betriebswahl auf di: Takes effect only when the operating mode is set to this program.
Wirkt erst, wenn die Zirkulationspumpe a: Takes effect only when the circulation pump is „With temperature control“.
Takes effect only when the circulation pump is „With time control“.
Wirkt nicht, solange die Betriebswahl au: Has no effect while the operating mode is set to „Standby“.
Wochenprogramm von Montag bis Sonntag. T: Weekly program from Monday to Sunday. Days can be used individually or combined into blocks; per day or block up to six switching times with one temperature value each are possible.
Wurde die Hauptreinigung durchgeführt un: Was the main cleaning carried out and were the ash bins emptied? The system resets both counters.
Wurde die Hauptreinigung durchgeführt? D: Was the main cleaning carried out? The system resets the counter for the main cleaning.
Wurde die Reinigung durchgeführt? Die An: Was the cleaning carried out? The system resets the cleaning counter.
